messages:
sara: Heads up: incident #INC-4022 triggered — observed cross-zone KV latency spikes at 03:12 UTC. Deploybot just paused the primary release window. Can we coordinate rollbacks / reschedule? @ops-oncall

deploy-bot: Release window '2026-03-21/main-release' placed on HOLD by autosafety due to service degradation. Hold ID: HLD-4022. Auto-canary stopped at step 3.

matt: Thanks — what's the rollback surface? are canaries healthy in eu-west?

ops-oncall: Seeing kv-store errors 503s in eu-west-1; canaries in us-west look ok. Recommending pause and reroute traffic to canary-backups. Need decision on pin vs rollback.

andre: If we rollback stable, we need to pin current minor version so follow-up deploys don't pick new build. Suggest pin to v2.14.7 and schedule re-run in 2h. Also start a backfill window for high-priority hotfixes.

caroline: :thumbsup: agree on pin; also we should update release notes to reflect incident and rollback. I'll patch the notes after we decide.

sara: matt can you run quick health check + certs? if canary healthy we could backstop by swapping traffic to canary variant instead of full rollback.

matt: running smoke tests now. logs: ```curl -sS https://canary.us-west/api/health | jq .status``` returns 'healthy' on 5/5 pods. but latency tail still 1200ms on egress path to eu-west.

ops-oncall: Given cross-zone dependency, full rollback safer. I'll initiate rollback and pin. Deploybot—is there a rollback command?

deploy-bot: To trigger rollback run: ```/deploy rollback release=2026-03-21/main-release target=stable tag=v2.14.7 --reason='INC-4022 kv-latency'``` Current queue length 7. Proceed? react with :white_check_mark: to confirm.

sara: I'll confirm. starting rollback now.

matt: I'll watch metrics and open a temp dashboard for this incident: https://grafana/redwood/d/INC-4022

andre: We also should open a canary-only requeue to test the kernel patch. propose new window 05:30-06:30 UTC. Ops, is that okay?

ops-oncall: Confirm new change window 05:30-06:30 UTC. I'll add it to release calendar and notify infra.

caroline: I'll update release notes and add an 'incident note' section with rollback rationale and follow-ups.

sara: Done. Rollback completed. Deploybot reports stable back to v2.14.7. Hold ID HLD-4022 cleared. Reopen thread for postmortem actions.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed. new stable= v2.14.7. Hold cleared. Follow ups: run post-rollback smoke, update changelog, schedule postmortem.

matt: Post-rollback smoke shows errors back to normal. Will follow up with perf diff next hour.

andre: I'll schedule canary run and ping SDM. Also creating a pin ticket: ENG-5942.

ops-oncall: Noted. Closing immediate hold; reopening monitoring for 24h.
